orders.thesis: Exceptional Q3 (record-high stock, favorable purchasing conditions) with +26% gap on 3.3x volume, closed at 0.97 of range while SPY fell 4.4% that day. Information-backed up-moves tend to drift as estimates rise; relative strength in a crash.
orders.wrong_if: The stock gives back the gap within days, closing below ~115, showing the earnings pop was overdone.

summary: Session 2026-11-06. Market crashed on 11-05 (SPY -4.4%, QQQ -6.5%, XLK -8%); pre-market is rebounding (QQQ +1.6%, SPY +0.2%). Held FIS and UNM shorts (pre-market flat, small gains, horizon 11-19). Examined screen rows: ECPG (+26%, record earnings, closed at high) was the one trade: long 4%, pattern 'news gap-up drift'. Passed on APP (+31% earnings, large, tech crash, mixed), EPAM/ADMA/ARDT/XERS/DLX (earnings pops, small caps with higher slippage or already faded pre-market), AEHL (not shortable, microcap). Passed shorting LOPE/STRA/BROS/TRIP/VCYT/CSV: all earnings-driven -17% to -54% drops, but shorting after big drops into a rebounding market is risky, and no clear info edge. Next session: check FIS/UNM/ECPG vs SPY; watch whether the market rebound continues (shorts could be squeezed); consider fading no-news moves; consider LOPE/STRA if the education sector drops further with news.
